description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three LLaMA-2 model variants — LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B — on the CoLeG-R benchmark (%), under four different fine-tuning conditions: no SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning), SFT on dataset D₀ only, SFT on D₀ and D₁, and SFT on D₀, D₁, and D₂. The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 85 with tick marks every 10 units. The horizontal axis groups the three model sizes, with four bars per group, each corresponding to a fine-tuning condition as indicated by the legend. The bars are color-coded and patterned: light blue with diagonal stripes for “no SFT”, light orange with horizontal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀”, light purple with diagonal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and solid light red for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. For LLaMA-2-7B, scores increase from ~67% (no SFT) to ~83% (full SFT). For LLaMA-2-13B, scores rise from ~70% to ~80%. For LLaMA-2-70B, scores go from ~80% to ~83%. In all cases, performance improves with additional SFT datasets, though the gains diminish at larger model sizes. The chart visually emphasizes that larger models benefit less from incremental SFT, while smaller models show more substantial relative improvements.
